'''Burntstrobe''' is a game modder whose image is used on two [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]].<ref name="cardlabels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The cards print the credit as "Image courtesy of Burntstrobe @ ModDB.com". The credit points to ModDB, a site for game modifications. The credited cards are [[Starkiller Base|•Starkiller Base]] and [[Starkiller Base (ALT)|•Starkiller Base (AI)]], in [[Virtual Set 8]] (released 2017).
